name: Danaher Front Headlock System
description: Navigate John Danaher’s The Front Headlock System by starting context and by control, submission or positional objective, with exact published lesson labels.
summary: Distinguish control, strangles and go-behind options across Danaher’s standing, kneeling, seated and passing front-headlock material.
overview: The Front Headlock System by John Danaher is not confined to a single choke. Its outline separates entries and positional contexts, then includes guillotine, anaconda, darce and go-behind material. Choose the context of your question before choosing a finish.

products.title: The Front Headlock System
products.blurb: Distinguish control, strangles and go-behind options across Danaher’s standing, kneeling, seated and passing front-headlock material.
products.best_for: You default to a guillotine whenever you reach the head and need to investigate the course’s positional alternatives.
products.study_focus: Start at Control vs Submission, then select the standing, kneeling, seated or passing context matching your question.

fits: You default to a guillotine whenever you reach the head and need to investigate the course’s positional alternatives.
consider_alternative_if: If the recurring problem is keeping an opponent down from turtle after an entry, compare Craig Jones’s Power Ride.

includes: Standing entries, kneeling attacks and seated front-headlock sections.
Go-behind options and a separate guard-passing volume.
limits: Front-headlock exchanges define the scope; this is not a general guard-passing survey or a complete turtle-riding curriculum.

start_here.title: Separate the positional question from the finishing question
start_here.task: In the public outline, compare Control vs Submission with Volume 5’s go-behind entries. Write down whether your current problem is reaching the headlock, retaining it, or selecting what comes next. Use that distinction to choose between the entry, control and attack sections; do not infer a mandatory choke-to-back sequence from their order.
